description: Backend API - Issues, Solutions, Votes, Comments, Tools, Search, User Profiles, AI Gateway, and WebSocket notifications. Complete REST API implementation for the entire Craq platform.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/services/issue.service.ts - IssueService with methods: create(authorId, data), getById(id), list(filters, pagination), update(id, data), delete(id), markSolved(id, solutionId), search(query, filters). Filters support: category, industry, stage, type, status, tags, trending, recent.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/controllers/issue.controller.ts - Endpoints: POST /issues, GET /issues, GET /issues/:id, PUT /issues/:id, DELETE /issues/:id, POST /issues/:id/solve.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/routes/issue.routes.ts.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/services/solution.service.ts - SolutionService with methods: create(issueId, authorId, data), getByIssue(issueId), update(id, data), delete(id), accept(id, issueId).

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/controllers/solution.controller.ts - Endpoints: POST /issues/:issueId/solutions, GET /issues/:issueId/solutions, PUT /solutions/:id, DELETE /solutions/:id, POST /solutions/:id/accept.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/routes/solution.routes.ts.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/services/vote.service.ts - VoteService with methods: vote(userId, targetType, targetId, value), getVotes(targetType, targetId), getUserVote(userId, targetType, targetId). Handles upvote/downvote toggle logic.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/controllers/vote.controller.ts - Endpoints: POST /votes, GET /votes/:targetType/:targetId.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/routes/vote.routes.ts.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/services/comment.service.ts - CommentService with methods: create(parentType, parentId, authorId, content), getByParent(parentType, parentId), update(id, content), delete(id). Supports threaded comments.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/controllers/comment.controller.ts - Endpoints: POST /comments, GET /comments/:parentType/:parentId, PUT /comments/:id, DELETE /comments/:id.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/routes/comment.routes.ts.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/services/tool.service.ts - ToolService with methods: create(data), list(category, filters), getById(id), addReview(toolId, userId, rating, content), getReviews(toolId).
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/controllers/tool.controller.ts - Endpoints: POST /tools, GET /tools, GET /tools/:id, POST /tools/:id/reviews, GET /tools/:id/reviews.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/routes/tool.routes.ts.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/services/user.service.ts - UserService with methods: getProfile(id), updateProfile(id, data), getReputation(id), getActivity(id), searchUsers(query). Reputation calculated from accepted solutions and upvotes.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/controllers/user.controller.ts - Endpoints: GET /users/:id, PUT /users/:id, GET /users/:id/reputation, GET /users/:id/activity, GET /users/search.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/routes/user.routes.ts.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/services/search.service.ts - SearchService with full-text PostgreSQL search across issues, solutions, users, and tools. Support filters by type, industry, tags, status.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/controllers/search.controller.ts - Endpoints: GET /search?q=&type=&industry=&tags=&status=.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/routes/search.routes.ts.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/services/ai.service.ts - AI Gateway service implementing: multi-provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Ollama, any OpenAI-compatible API), model switching, streaming responses, fallback chain logic. Methods: categorizeIssue(title, description), suggestSimilarIssues(title, description), generateSolutionDraft(issue), summarizeThread(comments), chat(messages, options). Each method tries providers in order until one succeeds.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/config/ai.config.ts - AI provider configuration with API keys, model names, endpoints, and fallback order. Support environment variable configuration for each provider.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/controllers/ai.controller.ts - Endpoints: POST /ai/categorize, POST /ai/similar-issues, POST /ai/solution-draft, POST /ai/summarize, POST /ai/chat (streaming).
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/routes/ai.routes.ts.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/services/upload.service.ts - Image upload service supporting local filesystem storage and S3-compatible storage. Methods: uploadImage(file), deleteImage(key), getImageUrl(key).
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/controllers/upload.controller.ts - Endpoints: POST /upload/image, DELETE /upload/:key.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/routes/upload.routes.ts.

Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/websocket/index.ts - WebSocket server for real-time notifications. Events: new_solution, solution_accepted, new_comment, upvote_milestone. Authenticate WebSocket connections via JWT.
Create /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/services/notification.service.ts - NotificationService that broadcasts events via WebSocket to relevant users.
Update /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/app.ts to mount all new routes.
Update /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/src/server.ts to initialize WebSocket server.
Create tests in /projects/sandbox/AbetArmy/craq/backend/tests/ for issue service, solution service, vote service, and AI service.
Verify: npm run build compiles all new code without errors. npm test passes.
acceptance_criteria: All CRUD endpoints for issues, solutions, comments, tools exist and follow RESTful patterns
Vote service handles upvote/downvote toggle logic correctly
AI gateway service supports multiple providers with fallback chain
AI service implements categorization, similar issues, solution drafts, and thread summarization
WebSocket server authenticates connections and broadcasts notifications
Search service implements full-text PostgreSQL search with filters
User profile service calculates reputation from accepted solutions and upvotes
Image upload supports local and S3-compatible storage
findings: All 36 files created/modified. Build passes cleanly. 34 tests pass across 5 test suites. Express req.params types need `as string` casting with @types/express v5. Used global fetch for AI service (available in Node 22). The solution routes are mounted at /api (not /api/solutions) to support nested /issues/:issueId/solutions paths alongside /solutions/:id direct paths.
